source: Roman 1987 / Delporte IAU boundary table via Astropy (CDS VI/42)
boundary_method: Shared edges of the exact partition induced by all Roman table breakpoints; transformed from B1875 to ICRS/J2000.
limitations: This is formal IAU region geometry, not an artistic asterism map.
The source table defines classification in B1875; ICRS/J2000 values are a deterministic coordinate transform for rendering.
